description: Runtime alert rules on a live trading desk in Svelte 5, no code required. Prices walk every second and end users define rules that watch the data and react: raise a toast, tint the row, flash the cell or log it. SvGridAlerts provides a visual condition builder reusing the grid's own filter operators or a free-text expression, persists rules to localStorage under storageKey, exports them as shareable JSON and feeds conditional formats back to the grid; the bell opens the fired-alert log and onJump scrolls to the row. Engine and overlay ship in @svgrid/enterprise.

faq.question: How does a rule reach the grid?
faq.answer: SvGridAlerts evaluates the rules against data as it changes and binds a formats array; passing it to the grid's conditionalFormats prop paints tints and flashes through the grid's own format pipeline.

faq.question: What can a condition contain?
faq.answer: Field comparisons with the same operators as the column filters, combined with AND and OR, or a free-text expression over the columns with arithmetic and functions; the builder and the expression compile to the same rule.

faq.question: How are rules shared?
faq.answer: The rule manager's Export button downloads the rules as alert-rules.json and Import loads a file back, and storageKey keeps each user's rules across reloads in localStorage.
